correctness.rationale: The primary source gives the exact triangular spectral quotient \(G(k)\) and the band condition \(-3/2\le G\le3\). Independent symbolic algebra factors the two boundary equations exactly as in the record. The broad-band inner edge obeys \(\tan(kd/2)=\sqrt3/(k\ell)\), producing a central-hole half-width \(\sqrt3/(\pi\ell n)+O(n^{-3})\) near \(2n\pi/d\). At odd centers the two relevant boundary branches give \(\tan(ds/2)=1/(\sqrt3u)\) and \(2u/(\sqrt3(u^2+1))\), whose two-band combined momentum width is \(4/(\sqrt3\pi\ell(2n+1))+O(n^{-2})\). Combining the endpoint holes and odd-center bands over one phase period yields the \(-4/(\sqrt3\pi\ell n)\) defect; harmonic summation gives the stated logarithm. Flat-band points have zero Lebesgue measure.
